input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button remains disabled after a failed export because the `busy` state is not reset when `exportReport` rejects. The error handling in `handleClick` only calls `setBusy(false)` on success, leaving the button greyed out if the fetch fails.

input.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function in the `ExportButton` component only resets the `busy` state to `false` when the `exportReport` promise resolves successfully. If the export fails (e.g., due to a non-2xx response), the `busy` state remains `true`, leaving the button disabled. To fix this, the `.catch()` or `.finally()` block should also set `busy` to `false` to ensure the button is re-enabled after a failed export attempt.

To fix this, the `.catch()` or `.finally()` block should also set `busy` to `false` to ensure the button is re-enabled after a failed export attempt.
